text: This report recommends approval of registration and travel expenses for Mr. Craig Shepherd, Senior Facility Coordinator to attend the first year and the second year respectively (2019 and 2020) of the International Association of Venue Managers (IAVM), Venue Management School.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Authorized expenses for Craig Shepherd, Senior Facility Coordinator to attend the International Association of Venue Managers in Tampa Bay, Florida in 2019 and 2020, at a cost not to exceed $6,000 plus HST per year.
